title: fix: stop forwarding client cloudfront-viewer-address to the legacy origins
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The legacy text and image Cloudflare cache Workers now remove an obsolete address header before forwarding requests to OVH origins. Regression tests cover forwarding in both caches.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and tidies the header labels on two little parcels headed from glowing text and image terminals toward a server, with lime green (#ecf874) vines framing the scene. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
